description:
At Gentex, you’ll help create innovative technologies that improve how people live, travel, and stay connected. Join a company driven by quality products across an evolving range of industries.

 CONTROLS ENGINEER: ROBOTICS FOCUS 
   
 POSITION OVERVIEW 
   
 The Controls Engineer will develop, deploy, and improve Gentex automated manufacturing systems, with a primary focus on robotics and robotic processes 
   
 WHAT YOU’LL DO 
 Provide support for new and existing automated systems. 
 Identify areas of improvement within existing automated equipment 
 Identify areas of improvement by studying data from Gentex software systems. 
 Develop programs for new and existing equipment, using both on-line and off-line programming techniques.  
 Actively participate in the evaluation and specifying of hardware and software for the automated equipment 
 Work with other Engineers to standardize automated and programming solutions across similar equipment, with heavy focus on robot point teaching methods, fixtures, and procedures. 
 Support engineering team members in the development of new processes for manufacturing. 
 Work with production support teams during equipment or software launch. 
 Research and develop new robotic solutions for automated equipment. 
 Identify and address areas of obsolescence. Work closely with maintenance to address spare parts, obsolescence, and other robotic maintenance needs.    
 Other duties as assigned. 
   
 HOW YOU’LL DO IT 
 Action oriented: Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm. 
 Attention to detail: Ensuring information is complete and accurate; following up with others to ensure that agreements and commitments have been fulfilled. 
 Communicating effectively: Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey clear understanding, taking into account the unique needs of different audiences. 
 Fostering teamwork: Building effective partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. 
 Maintaining high level of honesty, integrity, and confidentiality regarding company matters. 
 Complying with all Company policies and procedures, safety regulations, company safety policies and safely perform all duties , including but not limited to, promoting a safe workplace.   
 WHAT TO BRING 
 4-year Engineering degree or combination of education and equivalent controls engineering experience. 
 At least 3 years of experience designing, programming or integrating automated equipment and robotic solutions.  
 Proficiency in Microsoft Office. 
 WHAT WILL HELP 
 Experience with either AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical
 The ability to read and troubleshoot electrical schematics
 Exceptional troubleshooting skills, with mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic aptitude
